messages:
maggie (product): Heads-up — we need to finalize dependency contracts for the cohorted rollout. Goal: 3 customer cohorts with staged capacity and decreasing guarantees. Need runtime/infra/security tradeoffs and lead times by EOW.

hao (eng-runtime): Ack. I can own perf envelope for small/medium cohorts. Need 2 weeks to land prefix caching + KV eviction tuning. Also need clarified seq-length and typical prompt shape for 'medium' cohort.

derek (infra): We can provision reserved + burst slots but need QPS forecasts per cohort and a 90d reservation window for cost-effective commits. Also ask: will prewarm be on/off or per-tenant knobs?

sarah (security): From Security: KMS onboarding + HSM provisioning will take ~4 weeks including audits. SOC2 dataflow review for cohort telemetry must be scheduled — will block launch for regulated customers unless cleared.

vijay (eng-platform): I'll draft a dep-contract template with explicit SLAs, escalation matrix, and rollback triggers. Suggest we add a circuit-breaker policy: degrade to smaller model variant on sustained errors.

maggie (product): Action list: @hao produce perf numbers for "medium" seq length by Tue; @derek share cost model + tiered capacity by Wed; @sarah start KMS & dataflow checklist; @vijay open dep-contract PR. Call out blockers now.

derek (infra): One blocker: we need a scope freeze on prewarm interface (if API surface keeps changing infra can't finalize capacity shapes).

maggie (product): Propose freezing prewarm API to minimal controls: on/off + target_concurrency int. No other knobs for GA. Agree?

hao (eng-runtime): OK from runtime side. That simplifies integration.

sarah (security): Fine — smaller surface area is easier for review.

vijay (eng-platform): Will reflect that in the contract draft. Draft target: Fri EOD.

hao (eng-runtime): Also adding a quick config snippet for the circuit-breaker we discussed:

```
# circuit-breaker policy (example)
error_rate_threshold: 0.05  # 5%
window: 300                 # 5 minutes
action: degrade_to: "small-model-quantized"
notify: oncall-runtime
```

maggie (product): Nice. Launch criteria (must be met per cohort): 1) perf targets (p50/p95) met for cohort profile; 2) security checklist green; 3) capacity commit signed by infra; 4) dep-contract accepted by all owners. If any criteria fail we roll back to alpha lane.

derek (infra): I'll attach acceptance test plan and capacity tiers to the cost model. Expect to post by Wed.

ops-bot: deploy-bot created ticket PRJ-5234 for dep-contract draft assigned to vijay. :robot_face:

maggie (product): Cool — sync Wed 10am to validate drafts and signoffs. If anyone can't make dates call it out here. :calendar:
